greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lwakwaKristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendawo engenanto, apho ukuthula kwendlu kunzima ukukuthwala. Mhlawumbi uke wema ecaleni kwesango okanye kwibala leenqwelo-moya, ubukele iindiza zisuka, ucinga ngaloo mntu uphakathi kwethu owayekuthanda ukubukela iinjini neempiko zazo zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo thando. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, engajongi nje iindiza, kodwa ejonga ubukhulu bukaThixo obufihlakeleyo kwiimfihlo zenzululwazi kunye nobuchwephesha. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuzibona iindiza zayo zibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba sikhangele ngamehlo entliziyo. Uthi: 'Maye amehlo eentliziyo zenu akhanyiselwe, ukuze nazi ukuba liyintoni na ithemba elibangelwa kukubizwa kwakhe.' Amehlo entliziyo. Lawo ngamehlo angaboni nje izinto eziphathekayo, kodwa abona uthando lukaThixo olufihlakeleyo kuyo yonke imeko yobomi bethu. UBen wayengumfana owayenalo olo khanya. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye.

Khumbula lo mfanekiso: uBen, eneminyaka eli-15, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Ubenayo loo ntliziyo yayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukunika, owayethanda ukuba nomdla kwabanye, owayesoloko enoncumo olwaluthi, 'Ndikhona, ndiyakuthanda.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Gird your loins and light your lamps and be like servants who await their master’s return.' (Bhinqani izinqe zenu, nikhanyise izibane zenu, nibe njengezicaka ezilindele ukubuya kwenkosi yazo). Le ntsingiselo yokulinda ayiyiyo eyokulinda ngoloyiko, kodwa kukuhlala ulungele ukwamkela uthando oluza. UYesu uthi: 'Blessed are those servants whom the master finds vigilant on his arrival. Amen, I say to you, he will gird himself, have them recline at table, and proceed to wait on them.' (Nokuba uza kumlindo wesibini okanye wesithathu, bazukile abo bakhonzi). Mamele le nyaniso: uYesu akalindi nje ukuba sikhonze, kodwa uYesu uzimisele ukusikhonza. UBen, ngoku, usebukhoneni obo, apho uYesu emkhonza ngoxolo olungunaphakade.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha njengomsinga ongaqondakaliyo. Kukho imibuzo eza ebusuku, kukho imizuzu apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokuze nako kwenza ngokwahlukileyo. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi: 'Musa ukoyika.' Lo ngumyalelo, kodwa ikwangulwazi oluphilisayo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemkhono kaThixo, apho akukho ntlungu, apho akukho zifo, apho kukho kuphela uthando olungenasiphelo. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. UBen usengumntwana ononcumo, usengumntwana ocinga ngekamva, usengumntwana okhathalayo.

Namhlanje, masithathe oku: uBen wayengumfana owafunda ukunika. Masifunde nathi ukunika—ukunika iintlungu zethu kuThixo, ukunika ithemba lethu kuye, kwaye ukunika uthando lwethu kwabo basijikelezileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into.

Kukho amandla amakhulu ekuncedeni abanye. Njengokuba uBen wayenalo olo nqweno lokunika, kwaye njengokuba umsebenzi wamanzi acocekileyo eCà Mau uqhubeka ukhumbuza ihlabathi ngobubele bakhe, nani qhubekani niphila ngaloo ndlela. Niphilele uRyan, niphilele ukukhanya, niphilele ukuba uBen wayengumfana owafundisa ihlabathi ukuba uthando lukhulu kunako konke. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam, Yesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kule Ntsikelelo yeSakramente. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokusemthethweni kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ukhona, ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Malibe nani uthando lukaThixo, kwaye uMoya oyiNgcwele usikhokele ngoxolo. Hamba kakuhle.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abosizi, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade bethu: Ubabalo lwanikwa elowo kuthi ngokomlinganiselo wesipho sikaKristu. Ngoko ke ithi: Wenyuka waya phezulu, wathimba amabanjwa; wanika izipho ebantwini. Kuthetha ukuthini 'wenyuka' ngaphandle kokuba wathotywa kwimimandla ephantsi yomhlaba? Lowo wathotywayo nguye kwakhona owenyukayo waya ngaphaya kwamazulu onke, ukuze azale izinto zonke. Wanika abanye ukuba babe ngabaPostile, abanye babe ngabaprofeti, abanye babe ngabashumayeli, abanye babe ngabalusi nabafundisi, ukulungiselela abangcwele umsebenzi wenkonzo, ukwakha uMzimba kaKristu, de sibe sonke sifikelele kumanyano lokholo nolwazi loNyana kaThixo, ukufikelela kubudoda obukhulu ngokomlinganiselo wobukhulu obupheleleyo bukaKristu, ukuze singabi saba ziintsana, ezixhuzulwa ngamaza nezithwalwa ngumoya wemfundiso ngamnye, ngenxa yobuqhetseba babantu, nangenxa yobuqhinga babo kwizicwangciso zokukhohlisa. Kunoko, siphila inyaniso eluthandweni, kufuneka sikhule ngazo zonke iindlela kuye onguNtloko, uKristu, apho wonke uMzimba, udityaniswe waza wabanjwa ngazo zonke izihlanganisi ezixhasayo, ngokusebenza okufanelekileyo kwelowo nalowo malungu, uzizisa ukukhula koMzimba uze uzakhe eluthandweni.

readings.label: INdumiso yokuphendula
readings.text: R. Masinyuke ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Ndavuya bakuthi kum, 'Masiye endlwini yeNkosi.' Kwaye ngoku sise ezangweni zakho, O Yerusalem. R. Masinyuke ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Yerusalem, eyakhiwe njengesixeko esinobunye obuqinileyo. Kuso zinyuka izizwe, izizwe zeNkosi. R. Masinyuke ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi. Ngokommiselo wakwaSirayeli, ukubulela egameni leNkosi. Kuso kumiselwe izihlalo zomgwebo, izihlalo zendlu kaDavide. R. Masinyuke ngovuyo siye endlwini yeNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Abanye abantu baxelela uYesu ngamaGalili awayegazi lawo lixutywe negazi lemibingelelo yawo nguPilato. Wathi kubo ephendula, 'Ngaba nicinga ukuba ngenxa yokuba la maGalili ebandezeleke ngolu hlobo ayezoni ezinkulu kakhulu kunamaGalili onke? Nakanye! Kodwa ndithi kuni, ukuba aniguquki, nonke niya kutshabalala njengabo! Okanye abo bantu balishumi elinesibhozo babulawa xa inqaba yaseSiloam iwela phezu kwabo–ngaba nicinga ukuba babenetyala kakhulu kunabo bonke ababehlala eYerusalem? Nakanye! Kodwa ndithi kuni, ukuba aniguquki, nonke niya kutshabalala njengabo!' Waza wabaxelela lo mzekeliso: 'Kwakukho umntu owayenomthi womkhiwane otyalwe esidiliyeni sakhe, kwaye xa wayesiza kukhangela isiqhamo kuwo kodwa engasifumani, wathi kumlimi, "Kule minyaka mithathu ndizile ndikhangela isiqhamo kulo mthi womkhiwane kodwa andifumananga. Ngoko ke wuwise. Kutheni kufuneka udinise umhlaba?" Waphendula kuye wathi, "Nkosi, wushiye nakulo nyaka, kwaye ndiza kuwulima umhlaba ojikeleze wona kwaye ndiwufakele isichumiso; mhlawumbi ungaqhamisa kwixesha elizayo. Ukuba akunjalo, ungawuwise."'

day: Saturday of the Twenty-ninth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
